# Summary

**Accountant Classic** helps you track the gold your World of Warcraft characters earn and spend.

It records session activity and long-term totals, helping you understand where your money comes from and where it goes. Track income and expenses from vendors, loot, quests, repairs, mail, trades, and other in-game sources.

## Features

*   Track gold earned and spent during each play session.
*   Keep running income and expense totals for each character.
*   Review daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly summaries.
*   Switch quickly between characters to review their financial history.
*   Store character data separately by realm, including characters with the same name on different realms.
*   View location summaries to see where you earned or spent the most gold.
*   Use an optional floating money frame to monitor your current money in real time.
*   Open the main window from the minimap button, a key binding, the floating money frame, or the `/acc` command.

## Usage

Open Accountant Classic by using one of the following methods:

*   Click the Accountant Classic minimap button.
*   Type `/acc` in the chat window.
*   Assign a key binding in the WoW Key Bindings settings.
*   Right-click the floating money frame, if it is enabled.

The floating money frame displays your current money while you play. Right-click it to open the Accountant Classic window.

## Character and Realm Data

Accountant Classic keeps financial data separate for each character and realm.

This means characters with the same name on different realms do not share records. You can switch between saved characters from the Accountant Classic interface to compare their income, expenses, and historical summaries.

## History

Accountant Classic is based on the original Accountant addon, written by **Sabaki** for versions 2.1–2.3 and later updated by **Shadow** and **Rophy**.

Development of Accountant Classic continued with version 2.4 in 2007. **Arith** maintained versions 2.4–2.12, with **Tntdruid** contributing Garrison, barber shop, void storage, and transmog logging.

For versions 2.13–2.14 and 2.20, **kamusis** contributed bug fixes and improvements, including sorting in the All Characters view and baseline priming to avoid first-session balance skew.

Starting with version 2.21, **Arith** resumed development from the earlier 2.12.30 work, incorporating compatibility fixes and improvements from kamusis's revisions.

Thanks to **Losimagic**, **Shrill**, and **Fillet** for testing; **Razark** for the Atlas minimap icon code; and **Thiou**, **Snj**, and **JokerGermany** for early translations.

## Localization

Accountant Classic includes community translations for the following languages:

*   English
*   French — Thiou
*   German — Snj, JokerGermany, pas06
*   Traditional Chinese — arith, gaspy10
*   Simplified Chinese — arith
*   Korean — 막내, next96
*   Russian — Константин Гудович
*   Spanish — IsabelGarcia, unw1s3
*   Portuguese — Canettieri

Would you like to help translate Accountant Classic? Please contribute through the [localization page](https://wow.curseforge.com/projects/accountant-classic/localization).

## Issues and Suggestions

Found a bug, have a compatibility issue, or would like to suggest an improvement? Please submit it through the [issue tracker](https://wow.curseforge.com/projects/accountant-classic/issues).

When reporting an issue, please include:

*   Your game version and client type
*   The Accountant Classic version
*   Steps to reproduce the issue
*   Any error message produced by the game or an error-reporting addon

# Accountant Classic Revision History

## Known Issues

- Some incomes were categorized into Unknown instead of corresponding group.

## Revision History

### v2.30.07 (Nov. 23, 2026)
- Bug Fix: 
  - PR #22 (by kamusis):
    - Fix typo in Core/Constants.lua where constants.onlineData["Bank"] was set with mixed case for Client.isRetail instead of "BANK". 
  - Issue #21 (by Ortegas007):
    - handle missing period data when computing net money
    - correct tab argument in settleTabText

### v2.30.06 (Nov. 23, 2026)

- New feature: Zone breakdown drawer (PR #16, by kamusis)
  - Left-click a category row in the main window to open a side drawer listing where that money was earned or spent, by zone, with the sub-zones in each zone's tooltip. Zones are sorted by amount and shown with the total and the number of zones
  - Clicking the category name opens the larger of Incomings / Outgoings; clicking the Incomings or Outgoings column opens that one, and the drawer has buttons to switch between them. Clicking the same row again closes the drawer
  - Follows the selected character (or all characters of the realm on the All Chars tab) and period tab; the drawer sticks to the right side of the main window, or the left side when there is no room, and closes with it
  - The zone tooltip of a row now shows a "Click to view zone breakdown" hint, and is not shown while the drawer is already open for that row
  - New strings translated in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
- Minimap button: the tooltip can now show the income / expense of Today, This Week or This Month instead of only This Session (issue #18)
  - New option "Income / expense period" under Minimap Button Settings (default: This Session, as before); the tooltip shows the chosen period's name above the amounts
  - Also applies to the tooltip of LDB displays such as Titan Panel or ChocolateBar
- Bug fixes
  - All Chars tab: the sortable column headers (Source / In / Out) are now aligned with their columns, use a standard highlight, and are only shown on the All Chars tab, so they can no longer be hovered or clicked by accident on the other tabs (PR #15, by kamusis)
  - WoW Forever on Battle.net Asia: a new character on a Taiwan realm (e.g. "CAMWOW TW4 Realm 1 PvE") is now joined to its saved realm even when the client reports the region as KR. An exact region match still comes first; only then is a single saved KR / TW realm of the same ruleset used (PR #17, by kamusis)
- Enhancement
  - Removed the following rows from Forever:
    - Garrison / Class Order Hall Missions
    - LFG / LFD / LFR / Scenarios
    - Bank
- Development
  - Cleaned up the file header comments (replaced the old SVN $Id$ keywords)

### v2.30.05 (Nov. 22, 2026)

- Bug fixes
  - Changing the "Start of Week" option no longer starts a new week: before, the running week of every character was moved into "Prv. Week" and "This Week" started again from zero (issue #13). The week start is now only relabelled, and the week rolls over once the week that was running has really ended
  - Repair of the weeks moved by that bug: on login the amounts are moved back from "Prv. Week" into "This Week" (zone data included). The previous week they replaced can't be recovered, so "Prv. Week" stays empty until the next week change

### v2.30.04 (Nov. 21, 2026)

- Bug fixes
  - WoW Forever: since the November 20, 2026 hotfix the game no longer tells add-ons the realm name (GetRealmName() returns an empty string), so every Forever character was saved again under an empty realm, as if it were a new character
    - The realm of the current character is now found from its earlier record: Forever names are unique per region, and when the same name is saved under more than one realm (e.g. a copy from the beta), the history GUID, region, ruleset and last session date decide
    - A character first seen after the change joins the single earlier realm of the same region and ruleset, otherwise a ruleset realm such as "Forever TW PvE"
  - Repair of the records saved under the empty realm: on login they are merged back into the character's realm, together with the zone data and the history ledger. Day / week / month / year / total amounts are added up, the newer previous period is kept, and the newer balance and session date are used
    - Other characters are repaired at the same time when their realm is certain, otherwise on their own next login; until then they are listed under "Unknown Realm"
  - History ledger on Forever: a player GUID whose realm part changed no longer counts as a different character (the realm ID is being obfuscated)

### v2.30.03 (Nov. 12, 2026)

- Bug fixes
  - Fixed a Lua error "attempt to perform boolean test on a secret boolean value" from the history module every minute: on 12.0 UnitIsAFK() can return a secret value, which is now treated as not AFK (issue #7)

### v2.30.02 (Nov. 10, 2026)

- Improvements
  - Options: the settings are now split into separate sub-pages (General and Data Display Format, Minimap Button, LDB Display, Scale and Transparency, Character Data's Removal) instead of one long page
  - Removing a character now offers three choices: remove and keep its history (default), remove together with its history, or cancel. A kept history is marked as belonging to a removed character
- Development
  - Groundwork for an upcoming feature: a new saved variable (Accountant_ClassicHistory) and the embedded library LibBabble-SubZone-3.0. The existing logs, windows and saved data are unchanged

### v2.30.01 (Nov. 07, 2026)

- New log type: Bank
  - Buying bank tabs (character and Warband bank), Classic bank bag slots and the reagent bank are logged as Bank
  - Depositing gold into or withdrawing gold from the Warband bank is logged as Bank (guild bank gold stays under Guild)
  - Detected when the bank / Warband bank is opened, including remote access, and through the bank purchase / deposit / withdraw functions
- Bug fixes
  - Money was wrongly logged as Garrison (e.g. bank tab purchases, loot on Forever): the background events GARRISON_UPDATE and GARRISON_MISSION_FINISHED no longer switch the log type; only opening a garrison / order hall table or architect does
  - Loot money messages are now parsed with the client's own coin strings (GOLD_AMOUNT / SILVER_AMOUNT / COPPER_AMOUNT), with the addon translations as a fallback
  - Loot money is no longer counted twice when the balance is already updated before the loot message arrives
  - If a loot money message cannot be parsed, the following money change is still logged as Loot
  - Events missing on a client flavour are skipped instead of raising an error
- Development
  - Added Core/Annotations.lua with type declarations for the Lua language server / WoW API extension (namespace, constants, saved variables, profile, frames, LibUIDropDownMenu); not loaded in game and excluded from the package
  - Annotated the functions in every Core file; no warnings with the WoW API extension

### v2.30.00 (Nov. 05, 2026)

- Bug fixes

  - The character dropdown now remembers the selection by realm and character name, fixing wrong data being shown for the remembered character and the selection drifting when characters are added or removed
  - Fixed sorting the All Characters list by Updated date
  - Fixed a possible endless loop when the week start option is invalid

  - Removing a character now also removes its zone data and empty realm entries
  - Prevented errors for class tokens saved by other game clients, and on clients without InterfaceOptionsFrame

  - Fixed default options being shared between characters and a leaked global variable
- Improvements
  - All Characters tab: when a single realm is selected, only the character name is shown
  - All Characters tab: hovering a truncated character name shows the full realm and character name in a tooltip
  - Period tabs: the window title shows the selected character, e.g. "Accountant Classic - Character Name", since long realm names (such as Forever's) hide the character name in the dropdown
  - Period tabs: the portrait shows the class icon of the selected character, or the addon icon for "All Chars"
  - Rows are listed in a stable order
- Performance
  - The floating money frame is updated on money changes instead of every frame
  - Log rollover for all characters only runs when the day / week / month / year changes, instead of on every money change
  - Removed dead code and redundant option handling
- Code annotations and cleanup
- Changelog converted to Markdown (Docs/Revision.md)

### v2.21.03 (Oct. 15, 2026)

- ToC update to support WoW 12.1.5

### v2.21.02 (Oct. 07, 2026)

- Forever client now has its own WOW_PROJECT_ID which is WOW_PROJECT_CAMELOT
- Create centralized Client table to detect game client version and check in all relevant code sections
- Added auto-packaging for WoWInterface

### v2.21.01 (Sep. 28, 2026)

- Revised and enhanced the WoW version'd detection
- Handles the secondary name that brought in from Forever client, now we can tell the character's income properly
- Function name style change
- Prevents errors when viewing characters whose saved data lacks newer log-type or period entries

### v2.21.00 (Sep. 19, 2026)

- Improved compatibility with modern WoW APIs for option panel opening and settings categories.
- Replaced LibDialog-based confirmation popups with Blizzard's native StaticPopup flow for reset and character-removal actions.
- Fixed issues caused by removed/changed Blizzard APIs such as StaticPopup_DisplayedFrames and MAX_WATCHED_TOKENS.
- Enhanced first-run session tracking to capture the initial balance without losing the first properly identifiable money event. (thanks to kamusis)
- Improved money and currency display formatting for single-digit silver/copper and watched-currency output.
- Added sorting for the All Characters list by Character, Money, and Updated date. (thanks to kamusis)
- Added clickable sort headers to the Lua-created main UI with client-compatible sort indicators.

### v2.12.30 (Jan. 30, 2024)

- Library update: LibUIDropDownMenu

# Accountant Classic Revision History

## Known Issues

## Revision History

### v2.30.03 (Nov. 12, 2026)

- Bug fixes
  - Fixed a Lua error "attempt to perform boolean test on a secret boolean value" from the history module every minute: on 12.0 UnitIsAFK() can return a secret value, which is now treated as not AFK (issue #7)

### v2.30.02 (Nov. 10, 2026)

- Improvements
  - Options: the settings are now split into separate sub-pages (General and Data Display Format, Minimap Button, LDB Display, Scale and Transparency, Character Data's Removal) instead of one long page
  - Removing a character now offers three choices: remove and keep its history (default), remove together with its history, or cancel. A kept history is marked as belonging to a removed character
- Development
  - Groundwork for an upcoming feature: a new saved variable (Accountant_ClassicHistory) and the embedded library LibBabble-SubZone-3.0. The existing logs, windows and saved data are unchanged

### v2.30.01 (Nov. 07, 2026)

- New log type: Bank
  - Buying bank tabs (character and Warband bank), Classic bank bag slots and the reagent bank are logged as Bank
  - Depositing gold into or withdrawing gold from the Warband bank is logged as Bank (guild bank gold stays under Guild)
  - Detected when the bank / Warband bank is opened, including remote access, and through the bank purchase / deposit / withdraw functions
- Bug fixes
  - Money was wrongly logged as Garrison (e.g. bank tab purchases, loot on Forever): the background events GARRISON_UPDATE and GARRISON_MISSION_FINISHED no longer switch the log type; only opening a garrison / order hall table or architect does
  - Loot money messages are now parsed with the client's own coin strings (GOLD_AMOUNT / SILVER_AMOUNT / COPPER_AMOUNT), with the addon translations as a fallback
  - Loot money is no longer counted twice when the balance is already updated before the loot message arrives
  - If a loot money message cannot be parsed, the following money change is still logged as Loot
  - Events missing on a client flavour are skipped instead of raising an error
- Development
  - Added Core/Annotations.lua with type declarations for the Lua language server / WoW API extension (namespace, constants, saved variables, profile, frames, LibUIDropDownMenu); not loaded in game and excluded from the package
  - Annotated the functions in every Core file; no warnings with the WoW API extension

### v2.30.00 (Nov. 05, 2026)

- Bug fixes
  - Day / week / month / year logs now roll over without needing a /reload (dates were only read once at load time)
  - Classic: fixed GetBackpackCurrencyInfo being bound to the wrong variable
  - The character dropdown now remembers the selection by realm and character name, fixing wrong data being shown for the remembered character and the selection drifting when characters are added or removed
  - Fixed sorting the All Characters list by Updated date
  - Fixed a possible endless loop when the week start option is invalid
  - Resetting a period now also clears its zone breakdown; fixed the label for the previous year
  - Removing a character now also removes its zone data and empty realm entries
  - Prevented errors for class tokens saved by other game clients, and on clients without InterfaceOptionsFrame
  - "Reset position" of the floating money frame is now saved
  - The floating money frame now follows profile switching / copying / resetting
  - Fixed default options being shared between characters and a leaked global variable
- Improvements
  - All Characters tab: when a single realm is selected, only the character name is shown
  - All Characters tab: hovering a truncated character name shows the full realm and character name in a tooltip
  - Period tabs: the window title shows the selected character, e.g. "Accountant Classic - Character Name", since long realm names (such as Forever's) hide the character name in the dropdown
  - Period tabs: the portrait shows the class icon of the selected character, or the addon icon for "All Chars"
  - Rows are listed in a stable order
- Performance
  - The floating money frame is updated on money changes instead of every frame
  - Log rollover for all characters only runs when the day / week / month / year changes, instead of on every money change
  - Removed dead code and redundant option handling
- Code annotations and cleanup
